NewApp Privacy Policy

Effective 2026-10-21 · Version 1.0 · United States

Who we are

This policy explains how NewApp ("we", "us") handles information when you use our mobile application and related services. You can reach us for any privacy question, request, or complaint at support@newdomain.com.

Information we may collect

CategoryExamples
Account informationUsername or device identifier, profile details you add (name, age, gender, photos, preferences).
User contentMessages, posts, photos, and other content you create or share in the app.
Device and usage informationDevice model, operating system, app version, language, approximate region derived from postal code, and in-app activity.
Transaction informationRecords of purchases, subscriptions, and virtual currency balances processed through the app stores.
CommunicationsReports you submit, and messages you send to support.

How we use information

  • To create and maintain your account and session.
  • To operate core features: matching, chat, feed, and calls.
  • To process purchases and enforce entitlements, quotas, and fair-use limits.
  • To keep the service safe: moderation, spam and abuse prevention, enforcement of our Terms.
  • To communicate service changes, account notices, and responses to your requests.

How we share information

We may share information with: service providers that operate infrastructure we rely on (for example messaging and audio/video providers, payment verification through the app stores, crash reporting, and delivery services); authorities where required by law; and other users, to the extent you choose to share content with them. We do not sell personal information as that term is used under applicable state privacy law.

Advertising identifiers

Where the app includes attribution or advertising SDKs, the platform advertising identifier and limited device signals may be processed to measure installs or campaigns. You can reset or limit the advertising identifier in your device settings.

Data retention

We keep information for as long as your account is active, plus a period needed for legitimate business, safety, and legal record-keeping purposes after deletion. When you delete your account, profile content and user content associated with it are removed within the timeframe described on our Delete Account page, except records we must retain for legal, fraud-prevention, or accounting reasons.

Your choices and rights

Depending on your region, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to not be discriminated against for exercising these rights. California residents may request disclosure of categories of information collected and may opt out of any sale or sharing of personal information. To exercise any right, email support@newdomain.com or use the in-app account deletion option.

Children

NewApp is intended for users 18+ and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child is using the app, contact us and we will remove the account.

Security

We use encryption in transit and access controls appropriate to the sensitivity of the information. No method of transmission or storage is perfectly secure; please do not share sensitive information in chats with strangers.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy and will revise the effective date above. Material changes are surfaced in the app before they take effect.

Contact

NewApp · support@newdomain.com
